def _escape_text(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(path: str, pages: list) -> None:
    objects = []
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    kids = " ".join(f"{3 + 2 * i} 0 R" for i in range(len(pages)))
    objects.append(f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {len(pages)} >>".encode())

    font_names = {}
    next_font_idx = 3 + 2 * len(pages)
    for page in pages:
        for _x, _y, _size, font, _text in page["lines"]:
            if font not in font_names:
                font_names[font] = next_font_idx
                next_font_idx += 1

    for page in pages:
        page_num = len(objects) + 1
        content_num = page_num + 1
        font_res = " ".join(f"/F{k} {v} 0 R" for k, v in font_names.items())
        mediabox = page.get("mediabox", [0, 0, 612, 792])
        mm = " ".join(str(x) for x in mediabox)
        objects.append(
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [{mm}] "
            f"/Contents {content_num} 0 R "
            f"/Resources << /Font << {font_res} >> >> >>".encode()
        )
        ops = []
        for x1, y1, x2, y2 in page.get("rects", []):
            ops.append(f"{x1} {y1} m {x2} {y2} l S")
        for x, y, size, font, text in page["lines"]:
            ops.append(f"BT /F{font} {size} Tf {x} {y} Td "
                       f"({_escape_text(text)}) Tj ET")
        stream = "\n".join(ops).encode()
        objects.append(
            b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
            + stream + b"\nendstream"
        )

    for font, obj_num in font_names.items():
        objects.append(
            f"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /{font} >>".encode()
        )

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = [0]
    for body in objects:
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % (len(offsets))
        out += body + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)

    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off

    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (
        len(objects) + 1,
        xref_pos,
    )

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))

    return {"mediabox": list(mediabox), "lines": lines, "rects": rects or []}
